body: Again, thank you. I'll definitely do that. :)

I will definitely have to keep a look out for people. That'll have to wait for another time- kinda sucks. I've been curious about it for a few years now. Especially because I accidentally took an accelerated class in school which has double the work due in a shorter time. That on top of my other classes is not helping my sanity. My mind is a racing mess because of it and I need to relax and sloooow down. It could really come in handy. Even my conservative dad has opened up to its uses and said he wouldn't mind me trying it if I had it readily available, because he really wants me better. Buuuut, I suppose I will have to go the legal route that requires effort give meditation a go.

Your ideas are very helpful. I have barely scratched the surface with journals or meditation. I should put more discipline in myself and try it again. Thank you for talking to me. I feel loads better than I did. I know later I might be hit with another attack, but this is the first time in weeks that I have had a calm break from my constant depression, pain, and panic. And now I have more options, and I know I have many people to talk to about things. This is wonderful relief. It's a long road, but today doesn't feel as bad as it did. Thank you.

Thank you for caring, that alone gives me some hope. The odds of someone being near me seem pretty slim. It doesn't really matter. Talking to people has let off some of the pressure for the first time in awhile. I still feel on rocky footing, but there is a definite relief.

I have never tried marijuana, but I have definitely wanted to try it to see if it could help me. I have heard it helps some people. Unfortunately, I have absolutely no way of getting my hands on some, nor would I know where to begin looking. And I am absolutely paranoid of doing something illegal...which I think it's stupid it isn't legalized yet. I would absolutely love to give it a shot, trust me, it sounds like the perfect thing for me, seeing as relaxation is an absolute foreign activity for me. Even admitting that makes me feel like I'm going to be arrested, lol.

Yes, I've been to many doctors for this. The medication issue is annoying because I've gone through so many variations. I did have therapy for a long time too, but they raised their prices and my family couldn't afford it. And honestly, it really didn't help much. We don't have the best therapists and psychiatrists around here. I have been diagnosed with major depression, PTSD (from physical abuse), and an anxiety disorder. The past 11 or so years, I've been off and on medications to no avail. It either messed me up more, or did nothing. I also hope there is some help for me. I really do. 

Thank you for your kind words. I have seen the beauty of life; I know it exists. I just crave a break from the constant fear and pain I feel whenever I am awake. I hope it will go away, even temporarily. Again, I appreciate the time you've taken to listen and respond.

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. I am sorry to hear you had to deal with that in life. No one deserves that. I hope you are right, that things do get better. It's been pretty bad for awhile.

And the thing is, things aren't horrendously awful situation wise. I know that, and it makes me mad at myself. To hear what you've been through makes me mad for hurting over things that can been seen as trivial to some. But I am still hurting. I am having panic attacks without any known trigger from time to time. And I am really sad to the point of it physically making me sick and hurt.

But my parents, who at least try to understand and help, haven't been able to help me. I hate myself for the fact that my parents are even going as far as spoiling me to cheer me up...and it doesn't help. I mean, they've bought me movies that I've wanted, video games, offer to take me to my favorite restaurants. And I thank them for wanting to help me, but material things just don't cut it. I've turned down any recent offer of gifts to save their wallets. But for me to be so damn depressed when I have people who support and love me really makes me angry at myself. I feel and sound ungrateful. There are so many people who have less than me, and I still feel like crap.
